Download

A little help.

1. Upload a video. Drop an MP4, MOV, or WebM file to start automatically. Maximum size: 200 MB. Maximum duration: 10 minutes.

2. Let Whisper work. The multilingual model downloads on first use (about 75 MB) and is then cached by your browser. Processing speed depends on your device. An internet connection is needed for the first download.

3. Edit & export. Adjust text, timing, or style. Word highlighting uses AI word timing. After text edits, word timing is redistributed proportionally within the caption.

Projects and videos are saved in this browser on this device. Clearing site data deletes saved projects. A browser with WebAssembly support is required. Desktop Chrome or Edge is recommended.
